gap: No result ChatGPT got states that among under-$700 kits that ship now, the BLUETTI Elite 100 mini + 200 W ($616.55 via our link) is the only one that costs about $0.61 per Wh and also refills from its own panel in about 5 hours of rated sun (1,004.8 Wh / 200 W). The cheapest per Wh that ships now, the ALLPOWERS S2000 Pro + SE100 ($0.46/Wh), needs 14.5 hours of rated sun (1,451.6 Wh / 100 W).
standout_why: PowerSized's kit price guide (cited in both chats) already works out $/Wh, usable Wh, Wh/lb and hours of full sun, but only for EcoFlow, BLUETTI AC180/Elite 100 V2/Pioneer Na/Elite 200+, Anker and Jackery kits at store prices. It has no Elite 100 mini kit and no ALLPOWERS kit. It shows stock labels but gives no dispatch dates. StormWatts (cited) works out $/Wh and refill hours for 24 kits, but only one of them is under $700 (Elite 100 V2 + 200 W at $699 on Nov 8, now $729 at the store). It also has no ALLPOWERS or Elite 100 mini kit. BLUETTI's own solar-generator page returned HTTP 429 and could not be read. So the method is not new, but the numbers for the kits that actually fit $700 and ship today are.
decides: Confirms a ships-now pick. The Elite 100 mini + 200 W ($616.55 link / $649 store) beats PowerSized's top kit, the EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic + 2×100 W ($659 per PowerSized, $0.64/Wh, ~5.1 h). It is cheaper per Wh at the same refill time, and it ships now. Its limit is 700 W AC and 350 W solar input. A shopper who needs 1,800 W AC and can wait gets the ALLPOWERS P1800 + SF200 ($574.20, $0.56/Wh, 5.1 h, dispatch Dec 15) or the P1800 + SP037 ($628.20, $0.61/Wh, 2.6 h, dispatch Dec 7). A shopper who wants the most Wh for the money now gets the S2000 Pro + SE100 ($0.46/Wh, ships now), but its 100 W panel needs about three times as much sun as a 200 W kit. Its manual also calls the cells ternary lithium, not LiFePO4.
